RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday,  the March 20, 2008/Phalguna 30, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Coal; Communications and
Information Technology; Development of North Eastern Region;
Environment and Forests; External Affairs; Housing and Urban
Poverty Alleviation; Overseas Indian Affairs; Panchayati Raj;
Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions; Planning;
Shipping, Road Transport and Highways; Space;
Statistics and Programme Implementation;
Urban Development; Youth
Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 20
94
Bharatpur Sanctuary
*301. SHRIMATI SYEDA ANWARA
TAIMUR:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that to restore
the wetland character of Bharatpur
Sanctuary, it needs 850 million cubic feet
of water;
(b) if so, in what manner this alarming
situation is going to be handled, when after
optimum harnessing of all available
resources, like Chikana canal, Ajan Dam,
etc. water yield would be nearly 550 million
cubic feet; and
(c) whether Government of India and
the State Government of Rajasthan would
jointly step up co-ordinated efforts to help
save this world heritage status of Bharatpur
Sanctuary?
Realignment of Narol-Naroda section
of N.H.-8
*302. SHRI SURENDRA MOTILAL
PATEL:
SHRI JAYANTILAL BAROT:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING , ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any proposal has been
received from the State Government of
Gujarat for realignment of Narol-Naroda
section of National Highway No.-8; and
(b) if so, the present status of the
proposal?
Forest cover area in India
*303. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA:
SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) the total forest covered area in India

95
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
at the beginning of the First Plan, and its
present up-dated status, and in what manner
does it match with the targets fixed under
the National Forest Policy and its break-up
into dense forest, open forest and scrub
forest etc.;
(b) the amount of funds (Central and
State) spent for improving and extending
forest cover since first plan and what has
been achieved so far, till-date;
(c) the average expense per sq. km. of
additional forest cover thus achieved;
and
(d) in above context, the corresponding
statistics for Rajasthan?
Protection of  forest land
*304. SHRIMA TI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
a large area of forests has been wiped
out in the last two-three years as per
report released by the Forest Survey of
India;
(b) if so, the details of the States in which
forest land has been wiped out;
(c) the exact cause of huge kilometers
of forest land being wiped out;
(d) whether Government has since taken
any concrete steps to protect the forest land
from depletion; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Effect of environment on foodgrains
†*305. SHRI BHAGWA TI SINGH:
SHRI BRIJ BHUSHAN
TIWARI:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that change in
climate due to spoiled environment has
affected the production of foodgrains in
the country;
(b) if so, whether Government is
formulating any scheme to preserve
environment and forests; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
National Skill Development Mission
*306. PROF. P.J. KURIEN: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) the details of National Skill
Development Mission of the Union
Government;
(b) whether any proposal has been
submitted by the State Government of
Kerala under this scheme;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the action taken by Government in
this regard?
Asbestos factories
*307. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has recently
conducted a study through the National
Institute of Occupational Health to assess
the extent of betterment in the working
conditions in the Asbestos factories all over
the country;

96
(b) if so, a summary of the findings of
the study;
(c) whether the asbestos industry in the
private sector had contributed funds for
the conduct of the study in addition to the
allocation made by Government; and
(d) whether Government is likely to
present this report, finalised in consultation
with asbestos industry, at the Chemical
Review Committee of the UN at
Rotterdam in March, 2008 to rationalize
its third veto against UN sanctions on
asbestos industry?
Brahmaputra Waterways Project
*308. SHRI TARINI KANTA ROY:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) the present status of Brahmaputra
Waterways Project;
(b) whether Government has received
any demand for making this project an
"International Project"; and
(c) if so, the response of Government
thereto?
Signal towers installed by BSNL in
Goa
*309. SHRI SHANT ARAM
LAXMAN NAIK: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of signal towers installed
by Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL)
in Goa till date;
(b) the additional towers proposed;
(c) the names of towns and villages
where the additional towers are
proposed;
(d) whether BSNL has met with
opposition of members of public for
erection of such towers;
(e) the areas in which BSNL met with
opposition;
(f) the grounds advanced by the
members of public and response of the
Ministry to the same; and
(g) the details as regard the efforts made
by BSNL to educate members of public in
this regard?
Four laning of NHs in Rajasthan
*310. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
SHRI KRISHAN LAL
BALMIKI:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the State
Government of Rajasthan has proposed
four laning of NH-11 (Jaipur-Reengus-Sikar
Road section), NH-12 (Jaipur-Tonk-Kota-
Jhalawar road section upto MP border),
NH-14 (Beawar-Pali-Sirohi road section)
and NH-8 (Beawar-Udaipur section);
(b) if so, by when these National
Highways are likely to be four-laned;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
stretch between Chhitorgarh to Neemuch
of NH-79 and Jhalawar to MP border
qualifies for four-laning; and
(d) if so, by when these stretches are
likely to be four-laned?

97
Illegal coal mining
*311. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
SHRIMA TI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
due to illegal mining of coal, several tonnes
of coal is being looted by coal mafia from
coal fields;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the illegal coal mining
acitivities have increased in the coal fields
and the steps taken by Government to
check such illegal coal mining have proved
ineffective; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
concrete steps Government proposes to
take to prevent illegal coal mining from
various coal fields in the country?
Infrastructure development in BTAD
area, Assam
*312. SHRI URKHAO GWRA
BRAHMA: Will the Minister of
DEVELOPMENT OF NORTH
EASTERN REGION be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the implementation of
special financial package given to the Bodo
Territorial Autonomous District (BTAD)
to the tune of Rs. 100 crore per annum
started in 2002 for the last five years;
(b) the details of the funds released
and utilised, year-wise and scheme-wise;
and
(c) Government's policy, if any to
enhance the total amount of package for
infrastructure development in BTAD area,
Assam?
Repair of NH-17
*313. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
SHIPPING, ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether NH-17 is an important
inter-state port connectivity highway
providing a major link of economic
importance for movement of goods and
passengers within coastal Karnataka and
linking Kerala, Goa and Maharashtra;
(b) whether the bridges on this highway
are in a damaged state and require major
repair and re-strengthening;
(c) whether the State Government of
Karnataka has requested for upgrading the
entire length of NH-17 in Karnataka into
four-lane highway; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and
Governments response thereto?
Institutions for children of PIOs
*314. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA: Will the Minister of
OVERSEAS INDIAN AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of educational
institutions and universities that are
presently functioning or going to function for
the children of People of Indian Origin
(PIOs);
(b) the details thereof;
(c) whether Government is proposing any
projects for establishing new technical
education institutions for the children of
PIOs; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

98
Death of Indian students in USA
†*315. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
MISS ANUSUIYA UIKEY:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether cases of death of Indian
students in USA are increasing;
(b) whether information regarding
deaths and obtaining of the dead bodies is
also being delayed;
(c) if so, the steps being taken to stop
this;
(d) whether information is also being
obtained from the concerned families; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Loan to farmers against NSC/KVP
*316. SHRI ABDUL W AHAB
PEEVEE: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has signed a
Memorandum of  Understanding (MoU)
with HDFC Bank to provide loans to
farmers through post offices against
National Savings Certificate (NSC) and
Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP) in some States;
(b) if so, the States identified for the
purpose; and
(c) by when the scheme would be
operationalized?
Proposals from Orissa for roads and
bridges
*317. SHRI BHAGIRATHI MAJHI:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry has received
any representation from Government of
Orissa for the development of roads,
bridges, etc. during the last three years;
(b) if so, the total number of proposals/
projects received so far and action taken on
them till date;
(c) whether Government has any time-
bound programme to complete these
pending proposals of Orissa; and
(d) the total amount spent on each
proposal?
Spectrum allocation
*318. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that spectrum
allocation to CDMA telecom operators has
been delayed from June to December, 2008;
(b) if so, the details thereof and reasons
therefor;
(c) whether it is also a fact that launch
of 3G wireless services would be delayed
and face major problems with spectrum
allocation getting delayed; and
(d) if so, the steps Government
proposes to take for allocation of spectrum
before June, 2008?
Complaints regarding coal theft
†*319. MISS ANUSUIYA UIKEY: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the complaint of coal theft
by the officers of the company, coal
transporter in connivance with office bearer
of employees association have been
received from Bhaji Pani Open Cast
Western Coal Fields Ltd., Parasia, district
Chhindwara;
(b) whether headquarters of the Western
Coal Field Ltd., Nagpur Parasia has received
any complaint;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

99
(c) if so, the action taken thereon; and
(d) the findings of inquiry and efforts
that have been made to check the theft of
coal?
British PM's visit to India
*320. SHRI RAMDAS AGARW AL:
SHRI DARA SINGH:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the British Prime Minister
NEW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 14th March, 2008 Secretary-General.
Phalguna 24, 1929 (Saka)
visited India to attend "India-UK Summit"
in January, 2008 and held discussions with
the Prime Minister of India pertaining to
bilateral trade, Investment, climate change,
education, technology, transfer, etc.;
(b) if so, the details of the discussion and
outcome of the above mentioned summit;
and
(c) whether India has agreed to join as a
Member of "Financial Action Task Force"
to root out those who are seeking to use
terrorists' finance as well as combating
global terrorism?

Alleviation :—

Pensions :—

Shipping, Road Transport and
Highways : 302, 308, 310, 313, 317.
Space :—

Implementation :—
Urban Development :—
